## Summary

The claim: once your basics are down (gym, social skills) and a woman is actually *in* — sex plus a couple of weeks of hanging out — she will be "in utter awe of who you are and your seemingly basic competencies." This will feel "almost dishonest":

- You'll know three dishes and she'll stare in disbelief as you clumsily chop onions.
- You'll pick one interesting cologne bottle over $60 and hear "you smell so good" twice a day.
- Her filtering metrics are poor: follower counts, "twists knobs in front of a room of buzzed 30-year-olds" (DJ/status signaling) — biologically understandable, but a guy with some game and boundaries "slips in once in a while" and turns her concept of men and love upside down.

His prescriptions:

- The realization should bring "hope, renewed confidence, and a slight hint of pity" — even sane women struggle to see your value at first interface.
- **"Worry less about maximizing every vertical and more about being the right guy at the right time."** Guys actually in the arena have a *marketing* problem, not a product problem.
- Women are flooded with "cheap bottom-feeder male attention" — be patient with the ones in your orbit, not with the ones outside it.
- "Her not being able to see your value is her problem. If she can't, maybe her cute friend can."
- And: forgive yourself.

## Why it matters

- **The anti-optimization thesis, stated plainly** — the same argument as [[2026-11-04-swipehound-balls-over-performance]] (confidence over performance) from the demand side: her evaluation function is noisy, so marginal self-improvement has lower ROI than showing up with frame and boundaries at the right moment. It reframes patience as positioning, not passivity.
- **The attention-economics frame is the reusable part:** flooded evaluators under-price quality → value is recognized late and through proximity ("in your orbit"), which is an argument for consistency in social contexts rather than louder broadcasting.
- **Skepticism gates:** anonymous account, zero prior captures, no data — this is rhetoric with a moral, and the "awe" stories are unfalsifiable field anecdotes; engagement-bait cadence (numbered feel-good beats, sign-off "Your caudillo, Nuke"); the pity framing is ideologically loaded. Take the positioning logic, skip the contempt.
- Reference-only: mindset fuel, no task.
